heroHeadline: Day 955: Board of Peace Asks UNSC to Press Hamas to Disarm; Hamas Appoints October 7 Intelligence Planner Mohammed Odeh as New Military Commander — Kallner Inquiry Bill Advances Toward Late-May Knesset Vote With 42 Days to July 1 Accountability Deadline
heroSubtitle: The deadliest attack on Jewish people since the Holocaust — assault timeline, hostage crisis resolved January 2026, intelligence failures, and IDF response. May 19, 2026 (Day 955): Trump's Board of Peace formally asked the UN Security Council to press Hamas to disarm, calling demilitarization 'non-negotiable' in a high-level UNSC meeting — the most direct multilateral pressure on the Gaza ceasefire deadlock yet. Hamas rejected the Board's report as a 'dubious attempt to muddy the waters.' Phase Two negotiations (Hamas disarmament, Israeli withdrawal) remain in total collapse: all four Board of Peace deadlines (Apr 11, 14, 19, late-April) expired without agreement. IDF operational plans for a resumed Gaza ground offensive are complete, pending US authorization. One day earlier (May 18, Day 954): Hamas appointed Mohammed Odeh — former Hamas military intelligence chief and October 7 attack intelligence planner — as the new commander of the Al-Qassam Brigades, three days after the IDF killed predecessor Izz al-Din al-Haddad. Odeh's appointment signals Hamas's continued command reconstitution despite the IDF's sustained targeted killing campaign against all known October 7 planners. Hamas internal elections simultaneously progressed: Gazan members backed Khaled Meshaal for overall bureau head, Khalil al-Hayya as Gaza leader. Accountability front: 42 days remain until the Supreme Court's July 1 deadline. The Kallner inquiry bill — which dropped 'independent investigation' language and bars judges — advances toward a late-May first plenum reading; the opposition Beyachad alliance (Bennett-Lapid) has pledged an independent state commission as Day 1 of any new government. JPPI poll (May 15): 63% of Israelis support an independent commission. Gaza ceasefire: 2,400+ violations documented, 857+ Palestinians killed since Oct 10, 2025 ceasefire; Israel controls 60%+ of Gaza; less than $1B of $17B pledged reconstruction funds received.
